Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. The players are back out in the middle. Zawar Farid and Vriitya Aravind are the openers for the hosts. Craig Young to start off proceedings to Farid. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE...

270 to win for UAE then. Historically, the deck here gets better to bat on as the day progresses. But the home side will face a stiff challenge against the Irish bowlers. Stay tuned for the run chase.

The hosts started rustily with the ball, not having control but then spinners got the team back into the game. Skipper Ahmed Raza stifled the scoring rate while Rohan Mustafa gave him good company. The duo had combined figures of 20-1-89-3, which kept the Irish under check. However, they could not quite handle the death overs.

A good score posted by Ireland on a sluggish deck. They got off to a flier but then skipper Andy Balbirnie's wicket changed proceedings. Ireland suddenly lost their way, from 141/1 to 159/4. Amidst all these, Paul Stirling was playing a wonderful knock, ensuring that he did not throw his wicket away. He immediately shifted to first gear, moving his vehicle slowly, hunting for a partner to form a partnership. He found one in Curtis Campher and later, Gareth Delany, with whom he formed useful stands, teeing off in the end as well. 48 runs came in the last 4 overs.

The entire Irish team stands up and applauds Paul Stirling off. A workman-type innings, a hard-crafted one, never easy to play. He started with a bang, was forced to consolidate in the middle and then finished with a flourish. A really mature knock.
Around off, worked out to deep mid-wicket for a couple. IRELAND FINISH ON 269/5 as Paul Stirling carries his bat through, making an unbeaten 131.
FOUR! Misses this time. Stirling gets across his stumps for the paddle, Mustafa misses his length, darts in a full toss around leg and gets ramped past short fine leg.
Low full toss, terrific bowling, swung back to Mustafa again.
In the blockhole, no room to get under, dug out back to the bowler.
Shorter, outside off, Gareth backs away and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! The last over for Ireland begins with a boundary. Full toss, outside off, Delany comes down the track, swings hard, but gets a thick outside edge behind point. Ireland won't mind.

Around off, on a length, swung in the air towards deep mid-wicket. It looks like a catch but the wind does not let the ball carry to the fielder. It drops in front. A single taken. 8-0-53-0 for Zahoor today.
FOUR! Short ball, outside off, no pace, Delany waits and waits and waits for the slow coach to arrive and then hammers it over mid off.

Oohhh... hope Stirling is fine. A slower-ball bouncer, outside off, Paul looks to pull but plays it way too early. The ball comes in slowly, takes a bit of arm and then brushes the grille, before dropping down to the leg side. A leg bye taken.
That was a low full toss. Outside off, Delany backed away and punched it through the covers for one.
Yorker, outside off, right in the blockhole, dug out to long on for a run. Terrific bit of bowling.
Slower ball to start, short in length, outside off, pulled to wide long on for a single.
Zahoor Khan is back on. 7-0-45-0 so far.
SIX! BLUDGEONED! Number 99 for Stirling in ODIs. Full and around off, Paul gets underneath this one and sends it sailing over deep mid-wicket!
Yorker length, on middle, hit hard down to long on for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers. Delany wants the second but Stirling is in no mood.
This one keeps low a touch, short in length, dragged to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Yorker fired outide off, Stirling cannot get it away. Excellent take from the keeper.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Rohan Mustafa returns. 8-1-21-2 so far.

SIX! That was nowhere from the middle of the bat. A short ball, outside off, no pace offered, Stirling looks to pull but miscues it. But such is his power that the ball sails over long on! 10-0-56-1 for Kashif Daud. Impressive debut figures.
A bit of a delay here as Paul Stirling calls for a replacement bat.

Needless from Daud. Lack of composure from the debutant. A short ball, outside off, slower in pace. Delany looks to pull but mistimes it back to the bowler. Now, Daud tries to be cheeky and attempts a back-flick at the non-striker's end. He misses though and concedes an overthrow to long on.
Slower ball again, short in length, outside off, swatted to deep mid-wicket for a single.
The slower-ball bouncer is executed better this time, outside off, well inside the guidelines and not above the batsman's head. Paul lets it go, thinking it will be wided but it is deemed legal.
Short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! BLAST! Stirling's opening up now! A length ball, outside off, Paul swivels and swings this over mid-wicket!
WIDE Wild slower bouncer, outside off, left alone.

CENTURY FOR STIRLING! A fabulous knock. He has held this Irish innings together. His second fifty was slower than his first but it is understandable, given the trouble Ireland were in the middle overs. Has played a responsible knock. Gets there with a push through the covers for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Delany leans and drives this through the covers for one.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Miscue from Delany and a misfield from Point. Results in three runs.
Short and outside off, flayed through point for a single.
Length ball on off, pushed to wide long on for a single.
Back of a length on off, pushed to point off the back foot by Delany.
WIDE! Short and slower outside off, Delany makes a leave.
Length ball on the pads, Paul flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Length and outside off, Paul makes a leave.
Back of a length on off, punched through covers for a run.
Short of good length on middle, pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
Kashif Daud is back on. 8-0-33-1 so far from him.
Full and outside off, Gareth blocks it out.
Length and on off, Delany brings his bat-pad together and keeps it out.
Gareth Delany is the new man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Tossed up outside off, Curtis looks to go for the drive but ends up getting an edge. The ball flies towards backward point where Rohan Mustafa takes the catch.
Short of good length and outside off, Curtis cuts it to point.
Full on off, pushed to covers.
Back of a good length outside off, Paul slaps it through sweeper cover for a single.
Length and outsdie off, Paul runs it down to the third man region for a single.
Length and on leg, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Once again Khan goes short and Paul pulls it to the leg side for a single.
Short of good length and around off, punched through covers for a single.
FOUR! Pulled Away! Short and on middle, Curtis hammers the pull towards deep mid-wicket and gets a boundary.
Short of good length outside off, slashed through point for a single.
Zahoor Khan comes back on. 6-0-36-0 so far from him.
FOUR! LOFTED OUT! Full and outside off, Curtis lofts it over the bowler and fetches a boundary.
Short and outside off, cuts through point for a single.
Into the 90s! Length and outside off, pushed through covers for a couple.
JUST MISSED! Full and around off, Stirling pushes it but ends up getting an inside edge that just misses the leg pole.
Length and on off, pushed with soft hands to the off side for a run.
Length and outside off, pushed to short third man for a single.
Karthik Palaniapan is back on. 7-0-43-0 so far for him.
Full on off, pushed to long on for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, dabbed towards point.
Length and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
BEATEN! Short and around off, Curtis goes for the cut but the ball is too close to play that shot. He misses it though.

Length and outside off, pushed to mid off.
Power Play three time! Maximum of 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
On a length and around off, pushed to covers.
Back of a length and outside off, Curtis blocks it from within the crease.
WIDE! Length and down the leg side, Curtis lets it be. Wided.
Length and on off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Length and on off, pushed to mid off.
Back of a length around off, Curtis blocks it out.
FOUR! Length and outside off, Campher looks to push it through the off side but ends up getting a thick outside edge which runs down to the third man region for a boundary.
Zahoor Khan is back on.
Length and on off, pushed from the crease this time.
Length and outside off, Curtis pushes it to long off and gets a single.

Full and around off, pushed to the leg side.
Short and outside off, slapped through covers for a single by Campher.

10-0-46-1 (Balbirnie) is what Raza ends up with. A fine spell of bowling. Ends his spell with a fuller ball, around off, Campher drives it through the covers where the fielder dives to his right to stop the ball.
Around off, watchfully pushed to the off side.
Sensible batting, quietly taking the single after the boundary, with a back foot punch through cover.
FOUR! A boundary after a long time. Full and around off, Stirling gets down and across and sweeps it through square leg, powerfully. Moves to 81 from 108 balls.
Again the arm ball, outside off, watchfully played behind point for a single.
Full and outside off, Campher drives it back to the bowler.
Ahmed Raza is back on. 9-0-40-1 so far.
Yes, no, sent back in time. Outside off, PS looks to push and run to the off side again but is sent back once more. He is getting a bit itchy to be on strike it seems.
Around off, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.

NEARLY! Close shave for Stirling. On a length, outside off, Paul walks into the shot, looks to push and run to the off side for a single but the ball comes back in, takes the inside edge and scoots past the off stump towards fine leg. A run taken.
Back of a length, steep bounce, Campher gets on top of the bounce and fends it behind point for a run.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
The debutant is back on. Kashif Daud returns. 5-0-23-and the wicket of Kevin O'Brien so far.
Yorker length, around middle, dug out towards short mid-wicket.
Around middle, workd through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.

Around off, PS lunges and blocks.
Outside off, driven through the covers for a run.

Had he missed, it would have been timber. Full and straight, Stirling got down and across and played the sweep. Luckily for him, the ball took the under edge and went to short fine leg. A single taken.
Full and outside off, Paul looks to sweep but misses.
Outside off, Stirling looks to push but misses.

Curtis Campher joins Paul Stilring in the middle. DRINKS BREAK taken as well. Good passage of play for UAE. They have managed to curtail the run scoring and bounced back with a spree of wickets. They have taken 3/18 in 37 balls. Now, if they can get the set Stirling as well, they could dream of keeping Ireland to 200.

OUT! BOWLED! The Naagin dance is out again! Full and outside off, Tucker lunges to defend but the ball pitches, spins in like a vicious snake, goes between bat and pad and hits the timber! Mustafa does the celebration once again, with his second wicket in 11 balls and Ireland are wobbling a bit now.
Outside off, Tucker looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but the impact was outside off.

Pushed back to the bowler again, this time to the other side, the leg side.
Full and around off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Thrown up wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
Now he lunges, gets down on a knee, fetches the ball from outside off and sweeps it nicely but finds square leg.
Full and outside off, very slow, Paul looks to drive but is defeated by the slow away turn.
Around off, a touch fuller, eased down to long off for one.
Short and outside off, spinning away, cut through point for a run. Moves to 70 from 94 balls.
Around middle, punched towards long off for a single.

Around off, worked through long on for a single.
Outside off, pushed through mid off for a run.
Around middle, helped through mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! LBW! The Naagin dance comes out! Mustafa strikes and Tector is on his bike. Full and around off, pretty straight, Harry looks to defend but misses the straight ball. Is hit on the pads and the umpire immediately raises his finger on the appeal. Mustafa celebrates by doing the Naagin dance, which is normally seen being done by Bangladesh players.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended towards square leg.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Another wide. This is down the leg side as well.

Outside off, pushed behind point for a single.
Outside off, driven past Rizwan at cover this time for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to Chundangapoyil Rizwan at short extra cover.

Outside off, a touch short, punched towards short extra cover.
Full and wide outside off, plenty of width, flayed behind point. He calls for two and a fumble in the deep makes it easier.
Around off, pushed towards cover.
Around off, the arm ball, defended watchfully.
Full and around off, pushed to the leg side.
Outside off, driven towards cover again.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Landed outside off, stays low, blocked towards third man for a single.
Around off, blocked to the off side.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover.
Around off, steered through third man for a single.
Harry Tector joins Paul Stirling in the middle. A bowling change as well. Waheed Ahmed finally gets a go.

OUT! CAUGHT BY THE KEEPER! A great catch by Vriitya Aravind. It is very windy out there and certainly not easy to adjust. Full and outside off, Balbirnie looks to play the slog sweep but this time, Raza takes the ball away from him. So that means Andy has to reach out for the shot. Gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. To the naked eye, it seems like a simple catch but then mid-way, the wind takes the ball sideways. The keeper keeps his eyes on the ball till the last moment and yet, he has to dive. Manages to do so in the end and clasps the ball. Great catch. End of a fine 102-run stand.
Single again. Full and wide outside off, flayed through the covers.
A bit wide, outside off, punched through the covers for one.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Fired in outside off, pushed to sweeper cover for a run.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a quick single.
A short ball, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.

A short ball, outside off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
50 FOR BALBIRNIE! In just 55 balls. He has just been overshadowed by Stirling. Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Around middle, helped through square leg for a single to get his skipper back on strike.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Around off, helped towards square leg.

Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, Stirling looks to push and run to the off side but is sent back.
Full and outside off, slower ball, PS looks to drive but plays early. The ball goes off the bottom half of the bat towards mid off.
A bouncer now, around middle, Paul ducks.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Stirling lashes out the cut and gets it to the right of third man. The stand moves to 92 from 101 balls. Stirling moves to 60 from 76 deliveries.
Dropped short, outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, pressed watchfully behind point for a single.
Pace is back! Relief for us. Zahoos Khan returns. 3-0-20-0 so far.
Outside off, thrown wide, driven through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, eased down to cover for a run.
Short and outside off, cut behind point for a couple.
On a length, outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Paul lunges and works it towards short mid-wicket.
No pace whatsoever, dropped short outside off, getting some away turn, pushed towards short third man.
Slower ball, looped up, around middle, defended watchfully.
FOUR! That is a bad delivery. Short and way down the leg side, Stirling gets down and sweep-pulls it to the right of short fine leg.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SIX! BANG! What a way to bring up your half century. Full and outside off, Stirling gets down and mows a slog sweep over long on! His 25th 50 in ODIs.
FOUR! AUDACIOUS! Full and outside off, Balbirnie gets down, reaches out and sweeps it through mid-wicket, very powerfully.
Outside off, pushed towards point for a single.
Full and outside off, lofted inside out over cover for a couple. Good fielding in the deep.
Outside off, pushed through point but straight to the fielder.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and around off, worked through square leg for a single. Ahmed Raza has had a change of ends. 4-0-21-1 so far.
Around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done. Short and outside off, Balbirnie cuts it fiercely through point. Rohan Mustafa at point gets a standard regulation opportunity for a stop but he misses and the ball goes through.
Looped up, outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Around middle and leg, Stirling goes back and comfortably works it through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, no pace, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven through mid on for a single.
Full and around middle, Balbirnie walks into the shot and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Around off, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven down to long on for a single.
Full and around middle, pushed down to long on but the bowler intercepts.
Floated, around middle, punched towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, no pace again, Balbirnie has all the time in the world to go back and push it towards point.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
A drag down, but not much pace off the wicket. Stirling is through his pull shot a week too early and mistimes it through mid-wicket. Just a single.
Punched off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
LBW shout, not given. Around off, Stirling looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Perhaps the impact was outside off.
Around middle, helped through square leg for a couple.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers where Alishan Sharafu does well to keep the batsmen to a single.
Around middle, clipped through square leg for a couple.

DRINKS BREAK. Surprising that the umpires have called for the break now, when they could have actually done it when Karthik was bowling his opening over, but had to be paused due to a sightscreen issue. Anyway, Ireland have begun decently here but UAE have not done that badly either. Debutant Kashif Daud bowled with pace and precision while the spinners have kept the batsmen quiet. They managed to get Kevin O'Brien and would have had Paul Stirling as well, had his catch been taken. Let's see how the next passage of play goes.

Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Slowly looped up outside off, pushed towards long on for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to short third man.

DROPPED, FOUR! 'ARRE YAAR!' goes the keeper. Full and outside off, Stirling looks to play the slog sweep again. However, the ball hits the inner half of the bat and flies through to debutant Kashif Daud. But he is unable to catch it as the ball bursts through his hands, to the mid-wicket fence.
Full and outside off, Stirling gets down and mows it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A touch of room on the off side, punched through the covers for one.
Another one in the blockhole, dug out towards short mid-wicket.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Yorker, outside off, Stirling looks to dig it out to third man but misses. The keeper is unable to stop it and the ball deflects off his pads to short fine leg. No run taken though.
Around middle, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Finally a dot ball. Full and around middle, looped up, pressed defensively towards short mid-wicket.
Just too easy. Another single. Punched down to long on this time.
Good accumulation by Ireland. No risks at all and we have 4 singles in 4 balls. Another one pushed down to long off.
Very full, outside off, perhaps a wrong 'un, driven wide of long off again for one. 'Too full!' says the keeper to his bowler.
Full and outside off, nice loop again, spinning away, pushed down to long off for a run.
Full and outside off, nice flight to start with, driven through the covers for a single.

Karthik Palaniapan Meiyappan into the attack.  A wrist spinner. There is a bit of a delay. Seems to be some disturbance behind the sightscreen. Not because of anyone moving in front of it, but because the advertising hoarding has not been covered. With all this Covid bubble and all, there is a bit of unsurety in what not to touch and what to. The fourth umpire gets involved as well. Eventually, it is sorted.
Flighted, slower through the air, pushed towards point.
This is swept through square leg for a run.
On middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, change in pace, Balbirnie initially looks to flick but then changes his shot with a push to cover.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
Quicker one, outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Shorter again, outside off, pushed towards cover.
Slower ball, outside off, pushed towards point for a single.
Grip and bounce on this one, on a fuller length, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Good flighted delivery, outside off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around off, this time the lunge makes the bat meet the ball and push it towards long on for a single.
Huge LBW shout! Turned down. Was it doing too much? Full and around off, Balbirnie lunged to flick but missed and was hit on the pads. Could have gone down the leg side, but seemed very close.
FOUR! A full toss, down the leg side, swept through fine leg.
On middle and leg, Balbirnie looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Rohan Mustafa into the attack now.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Stirling leans and lofts it over cover!
Full and around off, eked out towards point.
Around middle, helped through square leg. A bit of a mix-up but all is well in the end.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Around middle, helped through square leg for a single.
On middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That is a fine shot. Full and around middle, driven through mid on for a boundary!
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Around middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! On a length, around off, helped through square leg.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Down the leg side, gently nudged towards fine leg for a run.

FOUR! In the air, but in the gap. The margin of error is so minimal when Paul Stirling is batting. Just a hint of width, outside off and Stirling likes it. Stays leg side of the ball and plays it over cover for a boundary.
Outside off, short in length, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, coming back in, Paul looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Yes, no, dot ball. Around middle and leg, Stirling turns it to the leg side, wants a single but then the fielder comes in quickly at square leg and Paul is sent back.
Outside off, on a length, Andy lets it go.
Outside off, Balbirnie defends it watchfully.
The skipper, Andy Balbirnie, walks in at number 3, replacing O'Brien.

OUT! BOWLED! The stumps are a mess! Kashif Daud has his first wicket in ODI cricket. He is elated and why shouldn't he be? It is of the big-hitting Kevin O'Brien. Full and outside off, O'Brien looks to whip it through the leg side but the ball comes back in a long way, finds the gap between bat and pad and hits the timber. Deserved a wicket, really. This has been an excellent opening spell.
Outside off, pushed behind point for a single.
On a good length, outside off, defended watchfully.
On a length, outside off, pushed towards point.
FOUR! ADMONISHED! Plenty of width, outside off, full as well, O'Brien lunges and hammers it over cover!
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for one.

Very well bowled. Gives this loop, outside off, entices Kevin to come down the track and then deceives the batsman through the air. KOB looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat, uppishly. But well wide of short mid-wicket, to his right. A run taken.

Fuller, around off, O'Brien gets a big stride forward and defends.

Around middle, pushed down towards mid on.
Ooohhh... that's lucky. Full and outside off, KOB looks to push it through the off side but the ball comes back in, takes the inside edge and just goes past the stumps!

FOUR! Width again, boundary again. Short and outside off, O'Brien lashes out the cut shot. Does not time it too well but the outfield is pretty quick and that side of the boundary is on the shorter side too. 4 boundaries in the last 7 balls for Kevin.
Finally gets it in the gap this time. A push through the covers for a single.
On a length, outside off. Stirling comes forward and pushes it to cover again.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over. O'Brien is getting in his zone now. A short ball, outside off, Kevin pulls it through mid-wicket. 12 from the over.
Slower ball, clever bit of bowling. On a length, outside off, pushed towards cover.
Better delivery, slight adjustment of length, in between full and good, outside off, driven towards mid off.
Around off, coming in, solidly defended.
FOUR! ELEGANT! This is even better. Half volley, outside off, a bit of width, O'Brien leans into the shot and drives it through the covers!
FOUR! WHOOSH! That is O'Brien's favourite stroke. A short ball, outside off, Kevin stamps on the back foot and pulls it over mid-wicket, one bounce and into the fence.

FOUR! Width and punished. Good end to the over for Ireland. Short and outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it, aiming to go through cover but does not quite middle it. However, has enough on it to get the ball to the ropes.
Around middle and off, turned towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and around off, driven straight to point.
That is interesting from Stirling. Jumps down the track but then lets the ball go outside off.
That comes back in a long way, beats Paul as he looks to defend and hits him on the pads. There is an LBW appeal but it is turned down. Perhaps the impact was outside off.
Half volley, wide outside off, driven straight to cover. Just a run from the over, off the wide but a wayward over from Zahoor.
Full and outside off, driven towards cover.
A length ball, just outside off, much better, O'Brien defends it watchfully towards mid on.

Back of  length, outside off, turned towards short mid-wicket.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off, pushed towards point.
Around off, on a length, pushed towards mid on.
Around off, nipping back in, pushed towards cover. Good first over in one-day internationals by Kashif Daud.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On a length, outside off, Stirling shoulders arms.
Full and outside off, driven with a nice, straight bat, towards mid off.

On a length, outside off, bit of a shape back into the right-hander, pushed towards cover.
Here comes the debutant. Kashif Daud to bowl with the second new ball.
Full and down the leg side, tickled fine of fine leg for a couple.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and down the leg side, Stirling flicks it down to fine leg for a single.
Around middle, flicked through square leg for a couple.

The players are out in the middle now. Kevin O'Brien will open the batting along with him. Zahoor Khan will open the bowling. Stirling to face.
PITCH REPORT - Since this is an early morning start, there will be something in it for the team bowling first. Once the day goes on, batting will get easier. The outfield is lush.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES (Playing XI) - Rohan Mustafa, Ahmed Raza (C), Zahoor Khan, Zawar Farid, Chundangapoyil Rizwan, Karthik Palaniapan Meiyappan, Alishan Sharafu, Kashif Daud, Vriitya Aravind (WK), Muhammad Usman and Waheed Ahmed.
IRELAND (PLAYING XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Gareth Delany, Mark Adair, Andy McBrine, Barry McCarthy and Craig Young.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. It lands in Andy Balbirnie's favour. IRELAND ELECT TO BAT.

COVID WORRIES! Oh dear. In a last-minute breaking news, the UAE have announced that CHIRAG SURI and Aryan Lakra have returned POSITIVE COVID-19 Tests. They have been placed under isolation and seem to be in good health. No other players have returned positive tests. Needless to say, both players have been ruled out of the series. The absence of Suri would be a bigger blow to the UAE, with him being one of their premier batsmen and also the vice captain of the side. Wish them good health.

Ireland are sailing in the same boat! They haven't had much cricket to play either. They come here for two series - first a 4-ODI contest with hosts UAE, which will serve as a prelude for the bigger contest - a 3-ODI series against Afghanistan later on. Ireland-Afghanistan is more on terms like the Ashes between non Test-playing nations and that would certainly be a contest worth watching. The Irish would like to use this series to fine tune themselves for that 'Ashes' series. Unlike certain Afghan cricketers, they are barely playing any T20 cricket, save aside Paul Stirling.

It is game time in the Middle East! After a forgettable 2020, which barely saw muh cricket being played, atleast for the UAE, the United Arab Emirates get ready to host Ireland for a 4-match ODI series. There is plenty of chitchat for this series, as UAE are broadcasting an international series involving their team for the first time across the globe. They will hope that it is a series to remember.
